notes (ranked, all optional unless the root decides otherwise):
1. `docs/attributions.md:22` says "no copy of its license or text travels with the plugin", yet the new `core.md` and `web-design` text restate frontend-design's directives closely. `plugin.test.ts` pins many of them verbatim (`#F4F1EA`, "The Elements of Typographic Style", "Number items only when the content is a sequence"). This is a licensing judgment, so the root decides whether the wording needs softening or the text needs rewriting. Smallest fix: reword the attribution so it does not claim independent text, and keep the Apache-2.0 row.
2. `docs/development.md:21` still lists `licenses/` in the `dist/` layout, but `dist/licenses` is gone. Remove `licenses/, `.
3. `docs/development.md` Branch protection, final sentence (`do_not_enforce_on_create`): it arrived in a8ccaa5 and has nothing to do with this change. Move it to its own commit or drop it.
4. `plugin.test.ts` "visual roles send the design guidance…" passes on 7a59dd0 as well, so on its own it proves nothing. The other two new tests do cover the change. Optional fix: assert that `frontend-design` is absent from the section.
5. `design-core/core.md` now has web-style directives (palette hex, ASCII wireframes, "competitor test") that TUI, mobile and desktop inherit. This may conflict with the "platform fidelity over invention" section. The visual roles also have no embedded floor if the criteria name no skill (`worker-visual/design.md`). Both are a design choice for the root.
